supervisor_summary: The revised forecasters now agree on the value-per-current-share basis: $1.14 cash less a working-capital cut plus 0.1 new share if the deal closes, otherwise the GPRO quote. The distribution is bimodal, with about 79% at $1.10-1.45 (closed or pending) and about 21% at $0.05-0.60 (broken). Their remaining spread comes from the undisclosed NWC threshold and a 72-76% closing probability, and no public source settles either because GoPro has not yet filed its merger proxy. My ladder is essentially their mean (median about $1.21, P(>=1.29) about 0.30, fair value about $1.10), with low confidence in any deviation. A pre-close quote below about $0.88 would signal that the deal is failing.
key_drivers: Deal consideration (s.2.6(b)): $1.14 cash plus 0.1 surviving share per GPRO share, so the close branch sits at about $1.10-1.45 and the right tail is negligible (V >= $3.23 needs S above about $21).

Closing probability of about 75% by the horizon. For closing: no financing condition, specific performance on the commitment letter, HSR-only clearance, Woodman about 57% of votes. Against: no reverse fee, a Parent formed 8/31, and no proxy filed by 9/27 against a 12/31/2026 outside date.
The undisclosed NWC threshold. Each $10M of shortfall costs about $0.046 per share, and roughly $30M a quarter of operating losses erode NWC. This decides the $1.16 and $1.29 strikes.
Break branch of about $0.33 with a bankruptcy tail: going-concern warning, $27M cash against $73M short-term debt at 6/30, and Yorkville convertibles due 8/2027.
A 9/25 quote of $1.29 above the forecasters' fair value of about $1.10, partly reflecting a retail rally after the deal.
